biography.zh-CN: 收到最后一位观众信号的航海者。她想找回的不是名场面，而是那些没人剪进视频的瞬间。
biography.en: A voyager who can still hear the last viewer. She wants the moments nobody clipped, not another highlight reel.

playstyle.zh-CN: 依次打出攻击、防御和信号牌完成航线，再用航标发动强力效果。
playstyle.en: Complete routes by playing Attack, Defense, and Signal cards, then spend Beacons on powerful effects.

biography.zh-CN: 被系统要求永远元气的偶像。她开始怀疑，偶尔不开心是否也应当属于自己。
biography.en: An idol ordered to stay cheerful forever. She is beginning to wonder whether bad days should belong to her too.

playstyle.zh-CN: 积累并分配应援，在防守、恢复和爆发之间切换。
playstyle.en: Build and distribute Support, pivoting between defense, recovery, and bursts.

biography.zh-CN: 失败记录被自动隐藏的玩家。她只想证明输掉一局并不会让一个人消失。
biography.en: A gamer whose losses are automatically hidden. She wants to prove that losing a round does not erase a person.

playstyle.zh-CN: 通过低费连击、重抽和主动重启打出高速回合。
playstyle.en: Chains low-cost cards, redraws, and deliberate resets into fast turns.

biography.zh-CN: 被完美队长协议困住的舞者。系统没有给她留下疲惫这个动作。
biography.en: A dancer trapped inside the Perfect Captain protocol. The system forgot to animate exhaustion.

playstyle.zh-CN: 按节拍交替组织攻防，以精确顺序积累强力回响。
playstyle.en: Alternates offense and defense on beat, turning precise sequencing into powerful echoes.

biography.zh-CN: 在反复本地化中拒绝被修正的自宅警备员。系统把她的毒舌标成了语法错误。
biography.en: A homebody resisting endless localization passes. The system has classified her sharp tongue as a grammar error.

playstyle.zh-CN: 把故障牌转化成资源，再将错误安装进敌人的行动序列。
playstyle.en: Turns Glitches into resources and installs bugs into enemy intent queues.

biography.zh-CN: 原生于虚拟世界的歌者。她不接受系统用“没有原版”来证明她不真实。
biography.en: A singer born virtual. She refuses the system's claim that having no original makes her unreal.

playstyle.zh-CN: 切换舞台姿态，在不同牌序中改变卡牌功能。
playstyle.en: Switches stage stances so card order changes what each card can do.

biography.zh-CN: 守着一间可能从未存在过的花店。她坚持虚构的花也可以真的开。
biography.en: Keeper of a flower shop that may never have existed. She insists an invented flower can still bloom.

playstyle.zh-CN: 种下延迟生效的种子，以当前风险换取未来回合的绽放。
playstyle.en: Plants delayed Seeds, trading present danger for future blooms.

description.zh-CN: 造成6点伤害。
description.en: Deal 6 damage.

description.zh-CN: 获得5点护盾。
description.en: Gain 5 Block.

description.zh-CN: 抽1张牌。若本回合尚未完成航线，获得1点带宽。
description.en: Draw 1. If no route was completed this turn, gain 1 Bandwidth.

description.zh-CN: 获得3点护盾并抽1张牌。
description.en: Gain 3 Block and draw 1.

description.zh-CN: 造成9点伤害并增加1点失真。
description.en: Deal 9 damage and gain 1 Distortion.

description.zh-CN: 造成8点伤害；若有航标，再造成4点。
description.en: Deal 8 damage, plus 4 if you have a Beacon.

description.zh-CN: 消耗1枚航标，对所有敌人造成11点伤害。
description.en: Spend 1 Beacon to deal 11 damage to all enemies.

description.zh-CN: 获得7点护盾。若上一张牌是攻击牌，再获得4点。
description.en: Gain 7 Block, plus 4 if the previous card was an Attack.

description.zh-CN: 获得10点护盾并抽1张牌，增加1点失真。
description.en: Gain 10 Block and draw 1. Gain 1 Distortion.

description.zh-CN: 获得1枚航标。移除。
description.en: Gain 1 Beacon. Exhaust.

description.zh-CN: 获得8点护盾；本回合下一张信号牌费用为0。
description.en: Gain 8 Block. Your next Signal card this turn costs 0.

description.zh-CN: 抽2张牌。若生命低于一半，获得6点护盾。
description.en: Draw 2. If below half health, gain 6 Block.

description.zh-CN: 对所有敌人施加1层虚弱。
description.en: Apply 1 Weak to all enemies.

description.zh-CN: 获得2点带宽和2点失真。移除。
description.en: Gain 2 Bandwidth and 2 Distortion. Exhaust.

description.zh-CN: 造成7点伤害；失真至少3时改为14点。
description.en: Deal 7 damage, or 14 at 3+ Distortion.

description.zh-CN: 造成5点伤害两次。消耗1枚航标时再攻击一次。
description.en: Deal 5 damage twice. Spend 1 Beacon for a third hit.

description.zh-CN: 获得14点护盾。下一回合少1点带宽。
description.en: Gain 14 Block. Lose 1 Bandwidth next turn.

description.zh-CN: 施加2层易伤。
description.en: Apply 2 Vulnerable.

description.zh-CN: 弃掉手牌并抽取同样数量。
description.en: Discard your hand, then draw the same number.

description.zh-CN: 获得5点护盾。若这是本回合第一张牌，抽1张。
description.en: Gain 5 Block. If this is the first card played this turn, draw 1.

description.zh-CN: 造成3点伤害，重复本回合已打出的每种牌类型一次。
description.en: Deal 3 damage once for each card type played this turn.

description.zh-CN: 获得1枚航标并抽2张牌。移除。
description.en: Gain 1 Beacon and draw 2. Exhaust.

description.zh-CN: 造成12点伤害。每有一张故障牌在弃牌堆，再造成2点。
description.en: Deal 12 damage, plus 2 for each Glitch in your discard pile.

description.zh-CN: 消耗所有航标，每枚获得5点护盾并造成5点伤害。
description.en: Spend all Beacons; gain 5 Block and deal 5 damage for each.

description.zh-CN: 恢复5点生命。失真至少3时额外抽2张牌。移除。
description.en: Heal 5. At 3+ Distortion, also draw 2. Exhaust.

description.zh-CN: 无法打出。
description.en: Unplayable.

description.zh-CN: 无法打出。回合结束时增加1点失真。
description.en: Unplayable. Gain 1 Distortion at end of turn.

description.zh-CN: 造成12点伤害并增加2点失真。
description.en: Deal 12 damage and gain 2 Distortion.

description.zh-CN: 抽2张牌并增加1点失真。
description.en: Draw 2 and gain 1 Distortion.

description.zh-CN: 所有敌人获得1层易伤，你增加1点失真。
description.en: Apply 1 Vulnerable to all enemies. Gain 1 Distortion.

description.zh-CN: 获得12点护盾。下一回合少1点带宽。
description.en: Gain 12 Block. Lose 1 Bandwidth next turn.

description.zh-CN: 造成4点伤害三次，增加2点失真。
description.en: Deal 4 damage three times. Gain 2 Distortion.

description.zh-CN: 获得2点带宽。战斗结束前最大生命减少4。移除。
description.en: Gain 2 Bandwidth. Lose 4 max health for this combat. Exhaust.

description.zh-CN: 把每一次停顿都标记为流失风险。
description.en: Flags every pause as a churn risk.

description.zh-CN: 造成6点伤害。
description.en: Deal 6 damage.

description.zh-CN: 获得5点护盾。
description.en: Gain 5 Block.

description.zh-CN: 它并没有消失，只是没人再能看见。
description.en: It never vanished. Nobody is allowed to see it.

description.zh-CN: 造成5点伤害并塞入1张乱码字幕。
description.en: Deal 5 damage and add a Scrambled Caption.

description.zh-CN: 获得4点护盾并施加1层虚弱。
description.en: Gain 4 Block and apply 1 Weak.

description.zh-CN: 上一段还没结束，下一段已经替你开始。
description.en: The next segment starts before the last one ends.

description.zh-CN: 造成4点伤害两次。
description.en: Deal 4 damage twice.

description.zh-CN: 下一次攻击获得3点强化。
description.en: Its next attack gains 3 power.

description.zh-CN: 预计响应时间：9999小时。感谢您的耐心。
description.en: Estimated response time: 9,999 hours. Thank you for your patience.

description.zh-CN: 造成8点伤害。
description.en: Deal 8 damage.

description.zh-CN: 恢复5点生命。
description.en: Heal 5 health.

description.zh-CN: 专门回收不够热门、但仍有人珍惜的片段。
description.en: Collects moments too unpopular for the platform but too precious to discard.

description.zh-CN: 造成10点伤害。
description.en: Deal 10 damage.

description.zh-CN: 塞入1张丢包并获得7点护盾。
description.en: Add Packet Loss and gain 7 Block.

description.zh-CN: 造成6点伤害并施加1层虚弱。
description.en: Deal 6 damage and apply 1 Weak.

description.zh-CN: 它闻不出危险，只闻得出“不符合模板”。
description.en: It cannot smell danger, only noncompliance.

description.zh-CN: 造成7点伤害并施加1层易伤。
description.en: Deal 7 damage and apply 1 Vulnerable.

description.zh-CN: 造成13点伤害。
description.en: Deal 13 damage.

description.zh-CN: 获得10点护盾。
description.en: Gain 10 Block.

description.zh-CN: 永远在笑，永远说对台词，永远没有下一站。
description.en: Always smiling, always on script, with nowhere left to go.

description.zh-CN: 造成9点伤害。
description.en: Deal 9 damage.

description.zh-CN: 造成5点伤害并塞入1张乱码字幕。
description.en: Deal 5 damage and add a Scrambled Caption.

description.zh-CN: 获得12点护盾和2点强化。
description.en: Gain 12 Block and 2 power.

description.zh-CN: 造成14点伤害；若玩家失真至少3，再造成4点。
description.en: Deal 14 damage, plus 4 at 3+ player Distortion.

description.zh-CN: 每场战斗开始时获得6点护盾。权益已结束，护盾显然没收到通知。
description.en: Start each combat with 6 Block. The benefits ended; the shield missed the memo.

description.zh-CN: 第一回合额外抽1张牌。
description.en: Draw 1 extra card on the first turn.

description.zh-CN: 最大生命增加8。
description.en: Increase max health by 8.

description.zh-CN: 战斗胜利后恢复3点生命。
description.en: Heal 3 after winning a combat.

description.zh-CN: 每场战斗第一次触发失真时少获得1点。
description.en: Prevent 1 Distortion the first time you would gain it each combat.

description.zh-CN: 每场战斗开始时获得1枚航标。
description.en: Start each combat with 1 Beacon.

description.zh-CN: 第一回合额外获得1点带宽。
description.en: Gain 1 extra Bandwidth on the first turn.

description.zh-CN: 每场战斗第一次攻击额外造成3点伤害。
description.en: Your first Attack each combat deals 3 additional damage.

description.zh-CN: 休整时额外恢复5点生命。
description.en: Heal 5 additional health when resting.

description.zh-CN: 生命低于一半时，每场战斗首次抽牌额外抽1张。
description.en: When below half health, the first draw of combat draws 1 extra card.

body.zh-CN: 系统要求你确认：人格数据可在“改善体验”时被永久改写。拒绝按钮正在改善中。
body.en: The system asks you to accept permanent personality edits made to improve your experience. The Decline button is being improved.

result.zh-CN: 你找到一段被藏起来的缓存。无聊有时也是一种武器。
result.en: You find a hidden cache. Sometimes boredom is a weapon.

result.zh-CN: 系统感谢你的配合，并象征性地修复了一点生命。
result.en: The system thanks you and symbolically repairs a little health.

body.zh-CN: 桌上有一杯还温着的水，杯底贴着“非重要资产”。
body.en: A still-warm cup of water is labeled NONESSENTIAL ASSET.

result.zh-CN: 普通的水。恢复8点生命。
result.en: It is ordinary water. Heal 8.

result.zh-CN: 你获得了一个完全没有通过资产审批的插件。
result.en: You acquire a plugin that definitely did not pass asset review.

body.zh-CN: 所有消息都显示为“内容积极健康”，包括求救。
body.en: Every message reads CONTENT IS POSITIVE AND HEALTHY, including the calls for help.

result.zh-CN: 空白里还有一条路。
result.en: There is still a route inside the silence.

result.zh-CN: 你受了4点伤害，但带走一段错误代码。
result.en: Take 4 damage and carry away a useful error.

body.zh-CN: 井底不断重复：“你可能还喜欢……”
body.en: The well repeats: YOU MAY ALSO LIKE...

result.zh-CN: 井沉默了。你获得航标插件。
result.en: The well falls silent. You gain a Beacon plugin.

result.zh-CN: 它推荐了一个递归弹幕。非常精准，也非常糟糕。
result.en: It recommends Recursive Chat. Accurate and terrible.

body.zh-CN: 会议纪要只有一句：角色可以休息，但数据不能。
body.en: The minutes contain one sentence: talent may rest; metrics may not.

result.zh-CN: 黑暗第一次显得安全。恢复10点生命。
result.en: For once, the dark feels safe. Heal 10.

result.zh-CN: 附件是一块备用电池。没有人解释原因。
result.en: The attachment is a backup battery. Nobody explains why.

body.zh-CN: 数字在0和1之间摇摆，像在犹豫你算不算一个人。
body.en: The counter flickers between 0 and 1, undecided whether you count as a person.

result.zh-CN: 数字停在1。你获得“最后在线”。
result.en: It stops at 1. You gain Last Online.

result.zh-CN: 你绕过了统计脚本，恢复5点生命。
result.en: You bypass the analytics script and heal 5.

body.zh-CN: 申诉原因最多十个字。系统的拒绝理由有三万字。
body.en: Your appeal allows ten characters. The rejection is thirty thousand words.

label.en: Write: She Is Not A Bug

result.zh-CN: 申诉失败，但错误留了下来。
result.en: Appeal denied. The bug survives.

result.zh-CN: 你避免了精神伤害，并恢复4点生命。
result.en: You avoid psychic damage and heal 4.

body.zh-CN: 没有名场面。七海只是对着窗外发了三分钟呆。
body.en: No highlight. Nana simply stares out the window for three minutes.

result.zh-CN: 你获得一张未被剪辑的瞬间。
result.en: You gain an Unclipped Moment.

result.zh-CN: 什么都没发生。你恢复7点生命。
result.en: Nothing happens. Heal 7.

body.zh-CN: 门上写着：仅限品牌友好情绪通行。
body.en: The door allows BRAND-SAFE EMOTIONS ONLY.

result.zh-CN: 门开了，并赠送一个过期会员。
result.en: The door opens and awards an expired membership.

result.zh-CN: 受3点伤害，获得“创过去”。
result.en: Take 3 damage and gain Crash Through.

body.zh-CN: 海面没有加载完成，但浪声是真的。至少七海这么说。
body.en: The sea has not finished loading, but the waves are real. Nana says so.

result.zh-CN: 你获得一张纸质海图。
result.en: You gain a Paper Sea Chart.

result.zh-CN: 恢复12点生命。
result.en: Heal 12.

title.en: The Dock That Does Not Exist

body.zh-CN: 七海记得这里有一艘船。留存协议说，这段记忆没有产生足够互动，因此从未发生。
body.en: Nana remembers a ship here. Retention says the memory never happened because it generated insufficient engagement.

result.zh-CN: 一条粉色航线从空海面上亮起。
result.en: A pink route lights across the empty sea.

result.zh-CN: 七海点头。相信并不妨碍验证。
result.en: Nana nods. Trust does not forbid verification.

body.zh-CN: 日志在同一个时间戳记录了“笑”“沉默”和“违规”。
body.en: The same timestamp records SMILE, SILENCE, and VIOLATION.

result.zh-CN: 矛盾没有让世界崩溃，只让它更像记忆。
result.en: The contradiction does not break the world. It makes it more like memory.

result.zh-CN: 恢复8点生命。系统把这叫作低效。
result.en: Heal 8. The system calls this inefficient.

text.zh-CN: 直播已结束。当前在线人数：1。
text.en: The stream has ended. Current viewers: 1.
Are you still there? Don't close this yet.

text.zh-CN: 检测到低传播价值情绪，正在替换为“元气”。
text.en: Low-retention emotion detected. Replacing with CHEERFUL.

text.zh-CN: ……它连我不高兴的资格都要优化。帮我找到第七码头，好吗？
text.en: ...It even wants to optimize my right to feel bad. Help me find the Seventh Dock?

label.en: First tell me where we are.

text.zh-CN: 最优人格已离线。请选择要保留的七海版本。
text.en: Optimal persona offline. Select the Nana version to preserve.

text.zh-CN: 它问错了。人又不是只能保存一个版本。
text.en: That is the wrong question. A person is not a single saved version.

text.zh-CN: 旧的虚环回不来了。但下一站可以由我们自己决定。
text.en: The old ring is gone. We can still choose the next stop ourselves.

label.zh-CN: 保留被大家记住的七海。
让七海决定接下来成为谁。
label.en: Let Nana decide who comes next.

label.zh-CN: 把互相矛盾的版本都留下。

text.zh-CN: 第七码头还是没找到，不过我找到了会回消息的人。也不亏。
text.en: Still no Seventh Dock, but I found someone who answers messages. Not a bad trade.

text.zh-CN: 噪声等级挑战已开放。温馨提示：提高难度不会提高客服响应速度。
text.en: Noise challenges unlocked. Increasing difficulty will not improve support response times.

title.en: No Sea at the Seventh Dock

subtitle.zh-CN: 在留存协议完成“最佳实践”之前，找回七海没有被剪辑的记忆。
subtitle.en: Recover Nana's unclipped memories before Retention finishes its best-practice version.

subtitle.zh-CN: 悲伤与沉默正在被批量替换。
subtitle.en: Sadness and silence are being replaced in bulk.

subtitle.zh-CN: 高光循环里没有退出按钮。
subtitle.en: There is no exit button in the highlight loop.

subtitle.zh-CN: 完美队长协议漏掉了疲惫这个动作。
subtitle.en: The Perfect Captain protocol omitted exhaustion.

subtitle.zh-CN: 有些语气不应该被修正。
subtitle.en: Some tones should not be corrected.

subtitle.zh-CN: 没有现实原型，不代表没有真实。
subtitle.en: No physical original does not mean no reality.

subtitle.zh-CN: 虚构的花也可以真的开。
subtitle.en: An invented flower can still bloom.
